status: DOCUMENT_ONLY; favourable reserve inclusion and imperfection allowance unresolved; actual adoption UNKNOWN

source_fragments.fragment: ### Reserve omitted on the favourable basis
Should the favourable figure include the stability reserve it currently leaves out?
Which imperfection allowance should govern that comparison?
What justifies `ship/model.js` gating that purchase on the record knockdown
| stabilityReserve | additional solved areas; no separate drawing | whole hull, unallocated |
| stabilityReserve-allocation | whole hull, unallocated | no complete drawn allocation |
The drawing and the bill disagree. This generated record preserves those disagreements; it does not approve a cap design.
The checks use smeared areas at full radius and do not resolve station lengths, sections or connections.
No aircraft has been built or flown.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Named record/favourable basis is validated; legacy null-basis calls infer the named basis from named knockdown identity. Other custom knockdowns require explicit basis.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: A source basis label or legacy default cannot adopt a physical allowance or establish matched evidence.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Whole-ship ledger chooses named default knockdown by basis when none is supplied; explicit custom input stays distinct.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: No source numeric knockdown copied; no selected default/allowance or matched configuration asserted.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Declared source material-world, safety-basis and skeleton stiffness/density identities feed source accounting.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: Declared model identities are not observed material properties or an adopted physical material/safety-factor policy.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Skeleton receives basis and knockdown and first sizes under that source input.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: A sizing call and its source result do not establish calibration or a physical collapse/eigenvalue result.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Source reports separate comparison worlds, including shell imperfection identity, on the source-sized member state.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: Separate source-world diagnostics are not matched measurements or an adopted imperfection allowance; no numeric suffix value interpreted as actual evidence.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Reserve starts uncharged; only the record-basis branch with an insufficient source shell-check margin invokes additional sizing, and only successful follow-up margin charges additional member increments. Favourable basis skips this branch.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: Record basis alone does not guarantee a charged reserve. Model-uncharged is not observed absence, negligible requirement or physical adequacy; no source numerical margin threshold copied/adopted.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.declared_identity: aI / aTh / aOe / aSp reserve increment families
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Additional inner-ring, theta-web, outer-extra and spoke area increments contribute to source reserve accounting.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: Family identifiers and billed increments do not supply complete drawn station/member/connection allocation or installed inventory.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Whole-ship ledger converts source areal reserve into the bill and includes source joint/efficiency accounting factors.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: Only identities/qualitative inclusion are traced; no mass/strength/lift calculation, source numeric coefficients or corrected bill supplied.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Reserve enters totalT and is returned as the named stabilityReserve ledger line.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: Source line inclusion differs from complete observed mass, approved comparison scope and physical feasibility.

declared_accounting_gating_mappings.qualitative_source_role: Source returns separate imperfection diagnostic and cap/other check identities; the main checksPass predicate is a model output.
declared_accounting_gating_mappings.comparison_gap: No passing source predicate or census generation can select the disputed reserve basis or establish complete physical collapse qualification.

requirements.existing_boundary: Published favourable-reserve and imperfection-allowance questions remain unresolved.
prospective_record_requirements: Original question/revision and comparison domain, source basis identities and historical custody
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: This paper does not answer whether favourable should include reserve or choose an imperfection allowance.

requirements.existing_boundary: Record/favourable/default/custom source inputs and conditional reserve branch have distinct accounting scope.
prospective_record_requirements: Original source configuration/material/revision and declared basis/imperfection provenance; comparable state and explicit unmatched inputs
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Named defaults or source constants are not adopted physical criteria; preserve conditional branch behaviour without numeric copying.

requirements.existing_boundary: Reserve is a separately billed line; census records additional solved areas with no separate drawing and no complete allocation.
prospective_record_requirements: Declared inclusion/exclusion and member-family/station/connection applicability from responsible sources, missing counterparts visible
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: An uncharged source line is not measured absence; extra source increments are not complete installed population or qualified design.

requirements.existing_boundary: Source imperfection worlds and source-sized states do not provide applicable matched observations.
prospective_record_requirements: Original unmodified matched material/imperfection/configuration record identities and domain applicability, supplied source comparison conventions
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: No record/favourable ranking or adoption follows from a formula, source-world label or generated predicate.

requirements.existing_boundary: Actual raw evidence, calibration, uncertainty and comparison records are unsupplied.
prospective_record_requirements: Raw source/acquisition/custody/revision, applicable calibration and uncertainty provenance and missing/incomparable evidence
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: No physical test, collapse/eigenvalue analysis, uncertainty estimate, sample count or measured allowance is invented.

requirements.existing_boundary: Proposed comparison custodians remain unassigned; adoption source and criterion are unknown.
prospective_record_requirements: Responsible source owner and adopted allowance/criterion provenance/version/applicability only when supplied; original decision custody
requirements.insufficient_or_disconfirming_evidence: Passing repository checks and source comments cannot adopt an allowance, answer the design question or establish physical feasibility/safety.
